nodes.title: Lattice valuations and the Jaccard distance

nodes.summary: Every Boolean algebra $B$ embeds in a power set algebra: there are a set $X$ and an injective map $f$ from $B$ to the power set of $X$ such that $f(a \sqcup b) = f(a) \cup f(b)$ and $f(a \sqcap b) = f(a) \cap f(b)$ for all $a, b \in B$, $f(\top) = X$ and $f(\bot) = \emptyset$.
